skill.name: ai-detector
skill.description: Review supplied content for AI-generated patterns and produce an evidence-based HTML assessment with a visual likelihood score.
skill.summary: Generate an HTML review of possible AI writing patterns with a circular likelihood indicator and a content download link.
skill.author: notegpt-official

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no findings, so no finding verdicts were required. The prompt requests content analysis and HTML reporting; no evidence found of prompt injection, credential access, or data exfiltration. Its likelihood scores have no documented validation and should not establish authorship.

content.user_title: Review Text for Possible AI Writing Patterns
content.value_statement: Writing patterns alone cannot reliably establish whether content was generated by AI. This skill organizes a qualitative assessment into an HTML report with supporting observations.
actual_capabilities: Review user-provided content for patterns associated with AI generation.
Assess the apparent likelihood of AI generation.
Generate an HTML report with evidence supporting the assessment.
Represent the likelihood score with a percentage-based circular indicator, ring fill, and color.
Include a download link for the analyzed content in the report.
limitations: The skill provides instructions, not a validated detection model or calibrated probability estimator.
Writing patterns can produce false positives and false negatives; results cannot prove authorship.
The source provides no accuracy benchmarks, language coverage guarantees, or scoring methodology.
HTML rendering and download behavior depend on the host environment; no implementation or browser testing is included.

use_cases.title: Editorial Content Review
use_cases.description: Review a submitted article for possible AI writing patterns before discussing specific observations with its author.

use_cases.title: Teaching Discussion Preparation
use_cases.description: Prepare an exploratory review of a consented writing sample without treating the result as evidence of academic misconduct.

use_cases.title: Draft Self-Assessment
use_cases.description: Examine your own draft for repetitive or generic patterns and review the supporting observations in an HTML report.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Short Passage
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this text for possible AI-generated patterns: [text]. Produce an HTML report and clearly state that the assessment cannot prove authorship.

prompt_templates.title: Request Supporting Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this draft: [text]. In the HTML report, quote relevant passages, explain each observation, and identify plausible human explanations.

prompt_templates.title: Specify the Report Elements
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [text] and generate an HTML report. Include a circular percentage indicator with matching fill and color, evidence, limitations, and a content download link.
prompt_templates.scenario: Detailed report generation with the requested visual elements.

prompt_templates.title: Account for Context and Uncertainty
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [text] given this context: [genre, editing history, language background]. Separate observations from inference, explain uncertainty, and label any percentage as uncalibrated.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review that considers alternative explanations.

output_examples.input: Review a promotional paragraph that repeats broad claims without concrete examples.
output: Illustrative report assessment: Repeated sentence structures and generic claims may resemble AI-generated writing.
Alternative explanation: A human author may use the same conventions in promotional copy.
The HTML report presents observations, an uncalibrated likelihood indicator, and a download link for the supplied paragraph.

output_examples.input: Assess a personal account with specific dates, varied sentences, and detailed observations.
output: Illustrative report assessment: The passage contains specific details and varied phrasing, but these features do not establish human authorship.
AI systems can produce similar details, and human editing can change the apparent writing patterns.
The report identifies the relevant passages and states the limits of its assessment.

best_practices: Use the report as a discussion aid and verify concerns through independent evidence.
Provide writing context and request alternative explanations for each observed pattern.
Remove sensitive information before submission and inspect the report and download link before sharing.
anti_patterns: Treating a generated percentage as a measured probability or proof of AI authorship.
Making disciplinary, hiring, or publication decisions solely from this assessment.
Submitting confidential content without permission or reviewing the host service's data handling.

faq.question: Can this skill prove that text was generated by AI?
faq.answer: No. It reviews writing patterns and provides an assessment, not proof of authorship.

faq.question: Is the likelihood percentage scientifically calibrated?
faq.answer: No calibration method or validation results are provided. Treat the percentage as an illustrative model judgment.

faq.question: What does the report include?
faq.answer: The instructions request evidence-based HTML, a colored circular percentage indicator, and a download link for the analyzed content.

faq.question: Which AI tools are listed as supported?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Report rendering depends on the host environment.

faq.question: Does the skill include a separate detection service?
faq.answer: No. The supplied file contains prompt instructions, without executable code or an external detection service integration.

faq.question: Is confidential text safe to submit?
faq.answer: The skill defines no privacy safeguards. Follow your host service's data policies and remove confidential information before submitting content.
